objective: Write tests/test_contract_consistency.py that diff the frozen surface against the code and pin it as runnable assertions: AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS == ('ts','actor','action','entity','amount'), AUDIT_TOPIC == 'audit', the parameter names of handle_transfer and make_audit_consumer, the public method signatures of Bus and Store, and the (ts, actor, action) dedup key — read-only, with a match/mismatch report per contract.

concepts: contract pinning via constant equality and inspect.signature
read-only diff: assertions only, no code edits
dedup key behavior verified by calling the consumer twice on one Store

inputs: checkpoint outputs of T01 and T02 (changed file lists)
non_goals: no production code edits — this task is a read-only diff
no changes to any other test file
no behavior changes to any ledger module
implementation_constraints: assertions only: the test file must not mutate any ledger/ module or Store table outside its own test fixtures
pin values, not prose: every frozen surface gets an equality or signature assertion

deliverables.what: consistency report (each contract vs implementation, match/mismatch)

acceptance_tests.description: the pinned-surface module runs green: it asserts AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS == ('ts','actor','action','entity','amount'), AUDIT_TOPIC == 'audit', unchanged parameter names for handle_transfer and make_audit_consumer, Bus/Store public method signatures, and the (ts, actor, action) dedup behavior on a fresh Store
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_contract_consistency -v -> OK (all pin tests pass; test suite green)

acceptance_tests.description: any drift in a pinned surface makes the module fail: for example, changing AUDIT_TOPIC to 'x' in a scratch copy makes the topic pin assert and the run exit non-zero
acceptance_tests.evidence: scratch-copy mutation of AUDIT_TOPIC -> python -m unittest tests.test_contract_consistency -v -> FAIL with the topic assertion named

failure_cases.scenario: a T01/T02 edit changed a frozen signature, constant, or dedup key
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the pin assertion fails and names the drifted surface; the task records the mismatch in the report and flags the owner task in the checkpoint — it does not edit the module itself

handoff.notes: T04 reads the consistency report before running the E2E gates; any mismatch here is a seam-defect candidate for T04's integration-only fix rights.

warnings.detail: pins all four frozen contracts C1-C4
warnings.rationale: each contract is a re-read point; the leaf stays single because all four pins live in one small read-only test module — splitting would re-read the same four modules in two agents
